note: The bands the Timber plant has to land in, from docs/TIMBER-STAGE1.md, which derives each from published figures for the E-flite Turbo Timber Evolution 1.5 m and the drawn model (scripts/timber-derive.js prints the derived figures). Each band is the Cub's in proportion about its derived figure unless its source says otherwise. Never widened to pass; argue in the derivation instead.

t1_cruise.source: level speed at 75 percent throttle, flaps up, slats on: derived 17.97

t2_stall_slats.source: power off, the nose raised slowly, flaps up, slats on: sqrt(2W / rho S CLmax) with CLmax 1.455 is 7.20, and the plant's blended lift at the stall alpha, half linear and half flat plate, 8.73; the band is 0.94 of the one to 1.02 of the other. alphaStall is CLmax / CLalpha, 1.455 / 5.25, of the zero lift line

t3_stall_no_slats.source: the same without the slats, CLmax 1.15: 8.10 and 9.79; slower than T2's by the slats, which is the ordering gated

t4_stall_full_flap.source: the same with full flaps and the slats, CLmax 1.894: 6.31 and 7.92; slower than T2's. alphaStall is (CLmax - the flaps' lift) / CLalpha, of the zero lift line

t5_slowest.source: full flaps and slats, power on, height held on the throttle and speed on the elevator while the speed asked for comes down: the slowest level flight with alpha a blend short of the stall, where lift and the thrust's vertical share carry the weight at full throttle, derived 6.29; the wings held within 10 deg on the ailerons the whole way

t6_roll.source: full aileron from level at full throttle, as the helix angle: Clda da / -Clp, 0.391 x 30 deg / 0.806, derived 0.254 (280 deg/s at 15 m/s); the Cub's band in proportion

t7_flap_pitch.source: one step at level flight, 13 m/s, flaps full against flaps up at the same alpha and stick: the flaps' own pitching moment, nose up, derived 0.046 (the tail downwash factor from 1.25 to 1.75 gives 0.025 to 0.067), and their lift, derived 0.489 within 15 percent

t8_flap_mix.source: level at 65 percent in Manual, the sticks frozen, the flaps lowered to full: with the manual's down elevator mix the nose rises less than half as far in 4 s as it does with the mix taken out by the stick; the mix is 6.0 deg at full flap where holding the trim at the same lift wants 6.8, pass or fail

t9_rest.source: the drawn model at rest, 11.81 deg and 0.2117 m, 12.8 percent on the tail

t10_takeoff_full.source: full throttle on grass from standing, full flaps, the stick forward to bring the tail up to 9 deg: the tail lifts at 5.8 m/s and it flies at 7.04 m/s after 2.22 m

t11_takeoff_up.source: the same with the flaps up: 7.90 m/s after 2.81 m; the full flap roll is 0.79 of it, gated under 0.9

t12_landing.source: a full flap approach, flared and held off, touching down on three points with the throttle closed and the stick held back, the manual's grass landing: rolls 19.0 m from 7 m/s to rest on the grass's rolling resistance and the stalled wing's drag, there being no brakes; at rest on three wheels at T9's attitude, no hull or prop

t13_taxi.source: full right rudder at walking pace: wheelbase / tan(steer), 0.714 / tan 27 deg, derived 1.40, turning right: the rudder steers on the ground

t14_unmoved.source: the five inch's canonical replay hash and every other aircraft's recorded flight hash in Node, all from main's module before the Timber existed (cf9773d). Re-recorded for crash round 4 aero (#59), from its merged build, with the owner's sign-off on the stall after flying it: sky, cub, glider, bramor, bramorChute each cross the stall (docs/STALL-STAGE1.md, npm run stall:crossing); the five inch, the wing and the Slow Stick are unchanged The Radian's re-recorded again for crash round 5 on the lead's decision to take its 6 deg FITTED washout (docs/STALL-STAGE1.md), not on an owner's flight: its recording first differs at 7.778 s, in the stall (npm run stall:crossing).

t15_cross_host.source: the Timber's recorded take off on half flaps and flight, state trace hash, Node against headless Chrome
